内翻性乳头状瘤表现为眶蜂窝织炎和泪囊炎。

Inverted Papilloma Presenting as Orbital Cellulitis and Dacryocystitis.

中文摘要

一名66岁女性，既往有银屑病和慢性鼻窦炎病史，因左侧眶部疼痛、眼球突出、上睑下垂和视力模糊就诊，疑似眶蜂窝织炎。影像学显示左侧前筛窦腔为中心、延伸至鼻泪管的强化软组织肿块，伴有骨侵蚀和眶内炎性改变，符合同侧眶蜂窝织炎。行内镜下手术切除，组织病理学证实为内翻性乳头状瘤，无高级别异型增生或癌。虽然既往报道中已描述过眶部受累，但以眶蜂窝织炎等继发性感染并发症为表现者罕见。本病例扩展了关于眶内翻性乳头状瘤各种临床表现的有限但不断增长的文献。

英文摘要

A 66-year-old female with a past medical history of psoriasis and chronic sinusitis presented with left orbital pain, proptosis, ptosis, and blurry vision, concerning for orbital cellulitis. Imaging revealed an enhancing soft tissue mass centered in the left anterior ethmoid cavity with extension into the nasolacrimal duct, with associated osseous erosion and orbital inflammatory changes consistent with ipsilateral orbital cellulitis. Endoscopic surgical resection was performed, and histopathology confirmed inverted papilloma without high-grade dysplasia or carcinoma. While orbital involvement has been described in prior reports, presentation with secondary infectious complications such as orbital cellulitis is rare. This case expands the limited, yet growing, body of literature on the various clinical presentations of orbital inverted papilloma.
